verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot ships a Code Review agent, an Autofix feature for vulnerabilities, and a workspace that lets developers 'review changes, and merge completed work' after agent-driven edits, directly supporting diff inspection and pre-merge checks. However, this is all first-party docs with no independent/hands-on validation of review accuracy, and there's no explicit mention of running test suites/CI checks as part of this flow. Missing for 10: independent evidence of review quality/false-positive rates, explicit CI/test execution integration, and hands-on developer accounts of catching real bugs before merge.
